# Motion Control AI

> > Motion Control AI provides Kling 3.0 AI video generation tools with advanced motion control, motion transfer, and image-to-video capabilities for creating animated content and motion posters.

The platform specializes in Kling AI video generation technology (versions 2.6 and 3.0), enabling users to transform static images into dynamic videos with precise motion control, copy video actions between clips, and create motion posters optimized for social media platforms like Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.

## Core Motion Control Tools

- [Motion Control AI: Kling 3.0 Motion Control Video Generator](https://motioncontrolai.com): Homepage: Kling 3.0 AI video generator with motion control from images
- [Kling 2.6 Motion Control - Copy Any Video Action for Free](https://motioncontrolai.com/kling-motion-control): Kling 2.6 Motion Control tool for precise video action copying and transfer
- [Kling AI Motion Poster: AI Image to Motion Poster Generator](https://motioncontrolai.com/kling-ai-motion-poster): Kling Video 2.6 Pro transforms images into motion posters for social media
